swayable.summary: The messenger argues that both parties, not just Republicans, are blocking independent voters by closing primaries, and that the real political competition happens in round one, not the general election. He speaks directly to camera, cites a Washington Post piece, and asks viewers to follow Open Primaries.
swayable.title: Both Parties Are Locking Out Independent Voters
